rows.hours: Chief Kings may be bound from 9 till 12 o'clock at noon, and from 3 till sunset.
rows.place: No special place stated. The four Kings of the cardinal points (Amaymon, Corson, Ziminiar, Goap) are only to be called on great occasions; otherwise they are invoked to send spirits under them.
rows.incense:
Frankincense/olibanum
Saffron
Ambergris
Musk
Lignum aloes
Balsam
Bay/laurel fruit
Cloves
Myrrh
Mastic
Cinnamon (777)
Red sanders (Heptameron, Sunday)
rows.colours:
Gold
Yellow
Saffron
Orange (Golden Dawn King scale for Sol)
rows.offerings:
Frankincense
Gold-coloured candles
Wine
Honey
Oranges/citrus
Sunflowers/marigolds
Formal courtesy and praise
rows.notes: Classical: Belial 'must have Offerings, Sacrifices and Gifts' or he will not answer truly, and Paimon called alone requires 'some offering'. Beleth must be received courteously and done homage 'because he is a great King'. The Goetia has a Hazel Wand and silver ring for Beleth (and for Purson/Amaymon). The offerings list is modern and solar in theme.

rows.hours: Dukes may be bound from sunrise till noonday in clear weather.
rows.place: No place stated; the condition is clear weather.
rows.incense:
Musk
Ambergris
Lignum aloes
Red roses
Violets
Saffron
Pepperwort/costus (Heptameron, Friday)
Sandalwood, myrtle (777)
Benzoin, rose, red sandal (777, Netzach)
rows.colours:
Green
Emerald green (Golden Dawn King scale)
Rose/pink
White/ruddy mixes (Agrippa)
rows.offerings:
Roses and other flowers
Perfume
Sweets, chocolate, honey
Sweet wine
Music, art, poetry
Green or pink candles
rows.notes: The Goetia gives no offering rule for Dukes as a class. The offerings are modern Venusian conventions.

rows.hours: Prelates may be bound any hour of the day.
rows.incense:
Saffron (Heptameron, Thursday; 777)
Storax
Benzoin
Lignum aloes
Ash seed
Nutmeg, cloves (Agrippa: odoriferous fruits)
Cedar (777, Chesed)
rows.colours:
Blue
Violet (Golden Dawn King scale)
Purple
Sapphire/sky blue (Agrippa)
rows.offerings:
Cedar or saffron incense
Fine wine
Rich, generous food
Blue/purple candles
Charitable donation in the spirit's name
rows.notes: The text says 'Prelates', and Mathers notes that 'Prince' and 'Prelate' are 'apparently used as interchangeable terms'. His rank list gives Princes/Prelates seals in tin. The offerings are modern Jovian conventions.

rows.hours: Marquises may be bound from 3 in the afternoon till 9 at night, and from 9 at night till sunrise.
rows.incense:
Aloes (Heptameron, Monday)
Camphor
White poppy seed
Frankincense
Myrtle and bay leaves (Agrippa: leaves)
Jasmine (777, Yesod)
rows.colours:
Silver
White
Blue (Golden Dawn King scale for Luna)
Violet (Yesod)
rows.offerings:
Clean water
Milk
White flowers
Jasmine
White or silver candles
Silver items
rows.notes: These are the only rank whose hours run through the night. The offerings are modern lunar conventions.

rows.hours: Presidents may be bound any time, excepting twilight, at night, unless the King whom they are under be invocated. (Manuscript: 'any hour of ye day, Excepting Twilight, at Night...')
rows.incense:
Mastic (Heptameron, Wednesday; Agrippa)
Frankincense
Cloves
Cinquefoil
Cinnamon, cassia, mace, citron peel (Agrippa: peels)
Storax, white sandal, nutmeg (777)
rows.colours:
Yellow (Golden Dawn King scale)
Orange (Hod)
Mixed/multicolour
rows.offerings:
Storax or mastic incense
Written praise or a published write-up
Coins
Orange/yellow candles
Study or teaching done in the spirit's name
rows.notes: Twilight is excluded, and night is excluded unless the ruling King is also invoked. The mercury metal is impractical and toxic. Peterson suggests electrum, and Mathers suggested silver+mercury or copper+silver alloys. The offerings are modern Mercurial conventions.

rows.metal_note: Copper and silver equally (text); iron suggested by Mathers
rows.hours: Counts or Earls may be bound any hour of the day, so it be in woods, or in any other places whither men resort not, or where no noise is.
rows.place: Woods or forests, or any place where people do not go, or where there is no noise.
rows.incense:
Pepper (Heptameron, Tuesday; 777)
Dragon's blood (777)
Euphorbium, bdellium, gum ammoniac, sulphur (Agrippa)
Sandalwood, cypress, lignum aloes (Agrippa: odoriferous woods)
Tobacco (777, Geburah)
rows.colours:
Red
Scarlet (Golden Dawn King scale)
Fiery/iron colours (Agrippa)
rows.offerings:
Dragon's blood or pepper incense
Strong spirits (e.g. whisky, rum)
Tobacco
Red candles
Physical effort or exercise dedicated to the spirit
rows.notes: The Goetia gives Earls copper+silver, not a Mars metal. Mathers wrote that Earls' seals 'should probably' be iron so Mars is not excluded, and the Mars attribution comes from that. The offerings are modern Martial conventions.

rows.hours: Knights may be bound from dawning of day till sunrise, or from 4 o'clock till sunset.
rows.incense:
Sulphur (Heptameron, Saturday)
Myrrh
Black poppy seed, henbane, mandrake root (Agrippa; toxic, not for burning)
Pepperwort root (Agrippa: odoriferous roots)
Assafoetida, scammony, indigo, sulphur (777: 'all Evil Odours')
Civet/myrrh (777, Binah)
rows.colours:
Black
Indigo (Golden Dawn King scale)
Lead/dark grey
Brown (Agrippa)
rows.offerings:
Myrrh
Black candles
Dark red wine or strong coffee
Salt
Silence, fasting or disciplined work
rows.notes: Furcas is the only Knight. Henbane, mandrake and some 777 Saturn items are poisonous or foul. The app should present them as historical data only and suggest myrrh instead. The offerings are modern Saturnian conventions.
